_doc: In-repo subset of the cross-cutting controls register (PROC-PIN-1107 C1/T2). The tests cannot read the owner's records, so this file carries only what the coverage tests need: control id, the evidence or write paths it must cover, which are covered, dated exceptions, and the test that proves coverage. The canonical, fuller owner register lives outside this repository; keep the two in step. No hosts or secrets.

controls.control: per-document pin held outside the rw-writable rows

exceptions.reason: acquired documents are served without pins (WED-ACQ2 V2)
exceptions.exit: signed or admin-written pins for acquired documents
